A Bad Combo
I know that all drugs effect people different, but from my experiences the combination of large amounts of xanax alcohol and cannabis gives you a comatose type state.
My first experience, was at a friend's b-day, i had arrived on about 2.5mg of xanax and began drinking beers and wild turkey liquor. I was having a great time during the night chilling around the fire popping a few more xanax and what not, until a bowl was passed around. shortly after the marijuana kicked it it was like a catalyst for paralisis, this paticular time i had no functions and continued to puke all night for about 3hrs unable to move myself or concentrate at all then after a small rest I felt completly sober and fine, this also happend at a diff birthday party a few weeks ago where all the same amounts of xanax and alcohol and canabis were used, other than i took 2.5 hits of decent gel tab acid, Some time into the night i smoked some weed, same thing after the pot paralisis few hours later fine, so my conclusion is that when taking xanax with alochol canabis is a destuctor to  motor skills.
